title: Application-data opener borrowed emission with lazy brace prefix
mode: source-demonstrated copy avoidance with generated local controls
scope: Avoid copying unchanged group-102 app-data opener and closer markers during DXF emission
Preserve the legacy behavior that prepends an opening brace to unbraced app-data names
Verify emitted marker values, caller immutability, reference resolution, and following-record framing

implementation.summary: The app-data writer now borrows the original DRW_Variant marker with std::string_view. Already-braced openers and closing markers are emitted directly; only an unbraced opening marker creates local owned storage with the same leading-brace insertion as before. The focused Wave 1 selector also asserts that unbraced caller-owned ACAD_REACTORS and ACAD_XDICTIONARY markers remain unchanged.

results.owningCTest: passed (2/2; Wave 1 0.45 s, DXF fixtures 3.82 s)

assessment.claim: The selected app-data emission path avoids temporary string copies for unchanged opener/closer markers. Unbraced opener normalization still allocates only its required emitted spelling. This is not an allocator-count, peak-RSS, or throughput measurement.
assessment.coverage: Generated controls cover braced and unbraced markers, ASCII/Binary DXF, typed common metadata, reference remapping, caller-input immutability, and following-record framing.
assessment.limitations: No full suite, peer parser, CAD application, external drawing, or persistent fixture was used.
